hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] && command -v docker >/dev/null && ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && { sudo -n sh -c 'test -e /etc/docker/daemon.json || { mkdir -p /etc/docker && echo "{\"registry-mirrors\":[\"https://mirror.gcr.io\"]}" >/etc/docker/daemon.json; }'; (sudo -n service docker start || sudo -n dockerd) >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 & } ; exit 0
